White House Teleprompter Operator Out of Job Amid Betting Allegations

A White House teleprompter operator, identified as Gabriel Perez, is no longer employed after allegations surfaced that he used inside knowledge to bet on Donald Trump's speeches via the prediction market Kalshi. An official confirmed Perez is out of his post but did not specify if he resigned or was fired. The allegations involve betting on the outcomes of Trump's speeches, which were displayed on the teleprompter he operated.
